featured_reviews.review_text: I had a genuinely frustrating experience at this electronic shop and wouldn’t recommend it to anyone. The owner was dismissive from the moment I walked in, acting impatient when I asked basic questions about the warranty and product specs. I ended up purchasing a laptop that developed hardware issues within three weeks, and when I went back for support he refused to honor the warranty, claiming it was “user damage” without even inspecting the device. He raised his voice instead of offering a solution and tried to push me ❌toward an overpriced repair service at his own workshop. The billing was also unclear, with hidden charges that weren’t mentioned at the time of purchase. On top of that, the staff seemed untrained and there was zero accountability when I asked for a manager. For a place that advertises “customer first service,” the reality is the exact opposite. Save yourself the headache and buy electronics somewhere that values honesty over a quick sale. The shop should be ban 😡😡 I will not recommend this shop to anyone....

featured_reviews.name: Jude Al Official
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Review for Vijay Sales – Mixed Experience, One Outstanding Employee

I had a very mixed experience with Vijay Sales that I feel needs to be shared.

We visited the store regarding an urgent issue with an iPad that we desperately needed for a very important international show involving celebrities from around the world. The website had clearly promised a 90-minute delivery, which was the sole reason we placed the order.

Unfortunately, when we approached the store, the Store Manager, Mr. Pravin, flatly refused to help us simply because the purchase was not made directly from his store. There was no attempt to understand the urgency, no willingness to guide us, and no sense of responsibility toward a customer who trusted the Vijay Sales brand. It was very clear that store targets mattered more than customer support.

Disappointed but not ready to give up, we went to the Customer Service department, where we met Simran—and this is where the experience completely changed.

Simran welcomed us warmly, listened patiently, and immediately took ownership of the issue. She went above and beyond by calling every possible contact on her list, trying every option within her control to resolve the problem. Her attitude, empathy, and commitment to customer service were exceptional and truly commendable.

Thanks to Simran’s relentless efforts, we finally received the iPad in time, and I was able to successfully pull off the international show. Her support made all the difference.

To be honest, I had stopped trusting Vijay Sales for over 7 years due to a similar bad experience at a Thane store. However, Simran’s service has restored my faith in the brand, and because of her, I can confidently say I am willing to shop at Vijay Sales again.

Vijay Sales should seriously reflect on how store managers represent the brand—and also recognize and reward employees like Simran, who truly embody what customer service should be.

Thank you, Simran. You are an asset to the company.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Jude Al Official, We thank you for the review. We are delighted to hear that you had such a great experience interacting with our team. We hope to serve you again soon-Team Vijay Sales
